subject: HEALTH
title: Health Education 7
description: A skills-based health course for early adolescence covering nutrition and physical activity, mental, emotional and social health, injury prevention and safety (including online safety), alcohol, tobacco/vaping and other drugs, growth and development, and personal and community health. Each unit pairs essential concepts with the eight CA health skills—analyzing influences, accessing valid information, communication, decision making, goal setting, practicing healthy behaviors and advocacy. Sensitive topics in the growth and development unit are designed for parent-led discussion consistent with family values.
framework: 2008 California Health Education Content Standards (Grades 7–8); 2019 CA Health Education Framework

standards.H-7.1.1.N: Identify the six major nutrients and their functions; describe how to use MyPlate and nutrition labels.
standards.H-7.1.4.N: Describe the benefits of and barriers to physical activity and healthy eating, including the relationship among diet, activity and healthy weight.
standards.H-7.2.1.N: Analyze internal and external influences (media, culture, peers, advertising) on food choices and physical activity.
standards.H-7.3.1.N: Access and evaluate valid nutrition information, including identifying fad diets and false claims.
standards.H-7.6.1.N: Set a personal goal to improve dietary practices and physical activity and track progress.
standards.H-7.7.1.N: Practice healthy eating, including planning balanced meals and snacks and proper food safety.
standards.H-7.1.1.M: Describe characteristics of mental and emotional health and the relationship among stress, emotions and physical health.
standards.H-7.1.3.M: Identify signs of depression, anxiety and suicide risk and describe ways to get help from trusted adults.
standards.H-7.1.6.M: Describe characteristics of healthy and unhealthy relationships, including bullying and cyberbullying.
standards.H-7.4.1.M: Use effective verbal and nonverbal communication, active listening and I-messages to resolve conflicts.
standards.H-7.5.1.M: Use a decision-making process to address social and emotional situations.
standards.H-7.7.1.M: Practice healthy strategies to manage stress, anger and difficult emotions.
standards.H-7.8.1.M: Encourage others to seek help and promote a positive, inclusive school and community climate.
standards.H-7.1.2.S: Explain the causes of common injuries and ways to prevent them at home, outdoors and in sports.
standards.H-7.1.5.S: Describe safe and responsible use of the internet and social media, including privacy and dealing with online predators.
standards.H-7.1.7.S: Describe emergency preparedness for earthquakes, wildfires and other disasters in California.
standards.H-7.5.1.S: Use a decision-making process to evaluate risky situations, including violence, weapons and gang involvement.
standards.H-7.7.1.S: Demonstrate basic first aid and how to respond to emergencies, including calling 911.
standards.H-7.1.1.A: Describe the short- and long-term effects of alcohol, tobacco, e-cigarettes, cannabis and other drugs on the body and brain.
standards.H-7.1.3.A: Explain the addictive nature of nicotine and other substances and the process of dependency.
standards.H-7.1.6.A: Describe safe use and storage of prescription and over-the-counter medicines, including risks of misuse such as fentanyl-laced pills.
standards.H-7.2.1.A: Analyze how marketing, media, peers and family influence decisions about alcohol, tobacco and other drugs.
standards.H-7.4.2.A: Demonstrate refusal skills to avoid alcohol, tobacco, vaping and drug use.
standards.H-7.8.1.A: Advocate for a tobacco- and drug-free lifestyle and community.
standards.H-7.1.1.G: Describe physical, social, mental and emotional changes during adolescence and puberty.
standards.H-7.1.4.G: Explain the structure and function of the reproductive systems and the role of hormones (parent-led).
standards.H-7.1.7.G: Describe the importance of sleep, hygiene and personal responsibility for health during adolescence.
standards.H-7.3.1.G: Identify trusted adults and valid resources for questions about growth and development.
standards.H-7.4.1.G: Demonstrate communication skills to set personal boundaries and respect the boundaries of others.
standards.H-7.1.1.P: Explain how communicable and noncommunicable diseases are caused, transmitted and prevented.
standards.H-7.1.3.P: Describe the importance of regular medical and dental checkups, vaccinations and health screenings.
standards.H-7.1.6.P: Explain how environmental factors such as air and water quality affect personal and community health.
standards.H-7.3.1.P: Access valid health information and health services in the community.
standards.H-7.8.1.P: Advocate for a personal, family or community health issue such as clean air, recycling or disease prevention.

units.title: Nutrition and Physical Activity
units.big_idea: Balanced eating and regular activity fuel a growing body; media and marketing influence choices.

units.title: Mental, Emotional and Social Health
units.big_idea: Managing stress, building healthy relationships and knowing when to seek help support well-being.

units.title: Injury Prevention and Safety
units.big_idea: Preparation and good decisions prevent injuries and keep people safe online and offline.

units.title: Alcohol, Tobacco, Vaping and Other Drugs
units.big_idea: Substances change the developing brain; knowing the facts and refusal skills supports drug-free choices.

units.title: Growth and Development
units.big_idea: Adolescence brings physical, emotional and social changes; sleep, hygiene, boundaries and trusted adults support healthy growth.

units.title: Personal and Community Health
units.big_idea: Preventing disease, using health services and advocating for a healthy environment protect individuals and communities.
